rows.speaker: LOUDSPEAKER
rows.hi: "लल्लन की मिठाई में आधी चीनी, आधी चालाकी!"
rows.text: "Lallan’s sweets are fifty percent sugar and fifty percent cunning!"
rows.back_en: "Lallan’s sweets are fifty percent sugar and fifty percent cunning!"

rows.speaker: LALLAN
rows.hi: अरे! ये किसने बोला?
rows.text: Arey! Who said that just now?
rows.back_en: Hey! Who said that just now?

rows.speaker: LALLAN
rows.hi: मैं तो… मैं तो बस मन में सोच रहा था!
rows.text: I was… I was only thinking that in my head!
rows.back_en: I was… I was only thinking that in my head!

rows.speaker: TITLE CARD
rows.hi: सुबह — मेले से पहले
rows.text: Morning — Before the Mela
rows.back_en: Morning — Before the Fair

rows.speaker: CHHOTU
rows.hi: चाचा! आज कौन-सी मशीन बना रहे हो?
rows.text: Chacha! Which machine are you building today?
rows.back_en: Uncle! What machine are you building today?

rows.speaker: JUGAADU CHACHA
rows.hi: ये है… "दिल की बात रेडियो"! जिसकी तरफ़ घुमाओ, उसके दिल की आवाज़ सुनाई देगी।
rows.text: Behold… the "Heart-to-Heart Radio"! Point it at anyone, and it reveals what's inside their heart!
rows.back_en: Behold… the "Heart-to-Heart Radio"! Point it at anyone, and it reveals what's inside their heart!

rows.speaker: GUDIYA
rows.hi: दिल की आवाज़? चाचा, दिल तो धक-धक करता है, बात थोड़ी करता है!
rows.text: Heart's voice? Chacha, hearts only go dhak-dhak, they don't go talking around!
rows.back_en: The heart's voice? Uncle, hearts only go thump-thump; they don't talk!

rows.speaker: JUGAADU CHACHA
rows.hi: करता है, बिटिया। बस कोई सुनता नहीं।
rows.text: They do speak, baccha. People just never listen.
rows.back_en: They do speak, child. People just never listen.

rows.speaker: JUGAADU CHACHA
rows.hi: देखो! पहला टेस्ट — शेरू!
rows.text: Look here! First test run — Sheru!
rows.back_en: Look here! First test run — Sheru!

rows.speaker: RADIO
rows.hi: मुझे भी लड्डू चाहिए! एक नहीं, दो!
rows.text: I want a ladoo as well! Not just one, but two!
rows.back_en: I want a sweet as well! Not just one, but two!

rows.speaker: CHHOTU
rows.hi: हाहाहा! चाचा, ये तो सच में काम करता है!
rows.text: Hahaha! Chacha, this actually really works!
rows.back_en: Hahaha! Uncle, this actually really works!

rows.speaker: JUGAADU CHACHA
rows.hi: पर ध्यान रहे, अभी ये पूरी तरह तैयार नहीं है। इसे कोई बाहर नहीं ले जाएगा!
rows.text: But remember, it is not fully finished yet. Nobody must take this outside at all!
rows.back_en: But remember, it is not fully finished yet. Nobody must take this outside at all!

rows.speaker: CHHOTU
rows.hi: बिल्कुल नहीं, चाचा!
rows.text: No way at all, Chacha!
rows.back_en: No way at all, Uncle!

rows.speaker: GUDIYA
rows.hi: बस थोड़ी देर के लिए…
rows.text: Just for a little while…
rows.back_en: Just for a little while…

rows.speaker: CHHOTU
rows.hi: मेले में बड़ा मज़ा आएगा!
rows.text: The mela is going to be so fun!
rows.back_en: The fair is going to be so much fun!

rows.speaker: RAJU
rows.hi: देखो मेरी पतंग! पूरे गाँव में सबसे ऊँची उड़ेगी!
rows.text: Look at my flying kite! It will fly the highest in the entire village!
rows.back_en: Look at my kite! It will fly the highest in the entire village!

rows.speaker: CHHOTU
rows.hi: अच्छा? रेडियो, ज़रा राजू के दिल की सुनाओ!
rows.text: Really? Radio, let's hear what Raju's heart has to say!
rows.back_en: Really? Radio, let's hear what Raju's heart has to say!

rows.speaker: RADIO
rows.hi: गुड़िया मुझसे अच्छी पतंग उड़ाती है… पर ये मैं कभी नहीं मानूँगा!
rows.text: Gudiya flies kites much better than me… but I will never ever admit that!
rows.back_en: Gudiya flies kites much better than me… but I will never ever admit that!

rows.speaker: GUDIYA
rows.hi: हाँ! सुना सबने?
rows.text: Yes! Did you all hear?
rows.back_en: Yes! Did you all hear?

rows.speaker: RAJU
rows.hi: अरे! ये… ये तो झूठी मशीन है!
rows.text: Hey! This… this is a total lying machine!
rows.back_en: Hey! This… this is a total lying machine!

rows.speaker: MASTERJI
rows.hi: बच्चो, कल स्कूल समय पर आना। अनुशासन बहुत ज़रूरी है।
rows.text: Children, come to school on time tomorrow. Discipline is extremely important.
rows.back_en: Children, come to school on time tomorrow. Discipline is extremely important.

rows.speaker: RADIO
rows.hi: काश कल भी छुट्टी होती… और मैं दिन भर सोता रहता।
rows.text: I wish tomorrow was a holiday too… so I could sleep all day long.
rows.back_en: I wish tomorrow were a holiday too… so I could sleep all day long.

rows.speaker: MASTERJI
rows.hi: ये… ये किसकी आवाज़ है?
rows.text: Whose… whose voice was that just now?
rows.back_en: Whose… whose voice was that just now?

rows.speaker: LALLAN
rows.hi: वो रहे! उनके हाथ में कोई जादुई डिब्बा है!
rows.text: There they are! They have got some kind of magic box in hand!
rows.back_en: There they are! They are holding some kind of magic box in their hands!

rows.speaker: GUDIYA
rows.hi: भागो!
rows.text: Run, run!
rows.back_en: Run, run!

rows.speaker: JUGAADU CHACHA
rows.hi: रुको! वो अभी तैयार नहीं है!
rows.text: Wait! That gadget isn't ready yet!
rows.back_en: Wait! That gadget isn't ready yet!

rows.speaker: CHHOTU
rows.hi: बच गए!
rows.text: Safe at last!
rows.back_en: Safe at last!

rows.speaker: GUDIYA
rows.hi: लल्लन चाचा का चेहरा देखा था?
rows.text: Did you see Lallan Chacha's funny face?
rows.back_en: Did you see Uncle Lallan's funny face?

rows.speaker: RADIO
rows.hi: सब बड़े हो गए… अब कोई कहानी सुनने नहीं आता।
rows.text: Everyone has grown up… nobody comes to hear my stories anymore.
rows.back_en: Everyone has grown up… nobody comes to hear my stories anymore.

rows.speaker: RADIO
rows.hi: आज भी बच्चों के लिए लड्डू बनाए थे… पर कोई आया ही नहीं।
rows.text: I made sweet ladoos for the kids today too… but nobody came at all.
rows.back_en: I made sweet treats for the kids today too… but nobody came at all.

rows.speaker: GUDIYA
rows.hi: दादी… अकेली बैठी हैं।
rows.text: Dadi… is sitting all alone.
rows.back_en: Grandma… is sitting all alone.

rows.speaker: CHHOTU
rows.hi: सुबह दादी ने बुलाया था… मैंने कहा, "बाद में, दादी।"
rows.text: Dadi called me in the morning… and I said, "Later, Dadi."
rows.back_en: Grandma called me this morning… and I said, "Later, Grandma."

rows.speaker: LALLAN
rows.hi: हम सब मेले में थे… और दादी यहाँ अकेली।
rows.text: We were all at the mela… while Dadi was alone here.
rows.back_en: We were all at the fair… while Grandma was alone here.

rows.speaker: MASTERJI
rows.hi: सच ही कहा था रेडियो ने।
rows.text: That radio spoke the honest truth.
rows.back_en: That radio spoke the honest truth.

rows.speaker: JUGAADU CHACHA
rows.hi: कुछ बातें रेडियो से नहीं… पास बैठने से सुनाई देती हैं।
rows.text: Some things aren't heard through radios… but by sitting close to each other.
rows.back_en: Some things aren't heard through radios… but by sitting close to each other.

rows.speaker: CHHOTU
rows.hi: दादी! मेला हम आपके पास ले आए!
rows.text: Dadi! We brought the whole mela right to you!
rows.back_en: Grandma! We brought the whole fair right to you!

rows.speaker: DADI
rows.hi: अरे! तुम सब यहाँ? मेला छोड़कर?
rows.text: Arey! All of you here? Leaving the fair behind?
rows.back_en: Oh! All of you are here? Leaving the fair behind?

rows.speaker: CHHOTU
rows.hi: सॉरी दादी। सुबह आपने बुलाया था और मैं नहीं आया।
rows.text: Sorry, Dadi. You called me this morning and I didn't come to you.
rows.back_en: Sorry, Grandma. You called me this morning and I didn't come to you.

rows.speaker: DADI
rows.hi: अरे पगले… तू आ गया, यही बहुत है।
rows.text: Arey paglu… you came back, that is everything.
rows.back_en: Oh, you silly child… you came back, that is everything.

rows.speaker: GUDIYA
rows.hi: दादी, कहानी सुनाइए ना!
rows.text: Dadi, please tell us a story, na!
rows.back_en: Grandma, please tell us a story!

rows.speaker: DADI
rows.hi: तो सुनो… मेरी पहली दिवाली की कहानी। तब इस गाँव में बिजली भी नहीं थी…
rows.text: So listen… the tale of my first Diwali. Back when our village didn't even have power…
rows.back_en: So listen… the tale of my first Diwali. Back when our village didn't even have electricity…

rows.speaker: LALLAN
rows.hi: और ये लीजिए दादी — मेरी मिठाई। आज पूरी चीनी वाली!
rows.text: And please take this, Dadi — my fresh sweets. Made with full sugar today!
rows.back_en: And please take this, Grandma — my fresh sweets. Made with pure sugar today!

rows.speaker: EVERYONE
rows.hi: हाहाहा!
rows.text: Hahaha!
rows.back_en: Hahaha!

rows.speaker: DADI
rows.hi: बच्चो, दिवाली दीयों से नहीं… अपनों के साथ बैठने से रोशन होती है।
rows.text: Bacho, Diwali isn't lit by lamps… it shines when we sit together with our loved ones.
rows.back_en: Children, Diwali isn't lit by lamps… it shines when we sit together with our loved ones.

rows.speaker: RADIO
rows.hi: अब तो लड्डू मिलेगा?
rows.text: Do I get my ladoo now?
rows.back_en: Do I get my sweet now?

rows.speaker: JUGAADU CHACHA
rows.hi: हाहाहा! इसका तो पक्का मिलेगा!
rows.text: Hahaha! For this one, you'll surely get it!
rows.back_en: Hahaha! For this one, you'll surely get it!

rows.speaker: END CARD
rows.hi: बड़ों के साथ समय बिताओ — उन्हें हमारी उतनी ही ज़रूरत है जितनी हमें उनकी।
rows.text: Spend time with your elders — they need us just as much as we need them.
rows.back_en: Spend time with your elders — they need us just as much as we need them.
